events.brand: Peanuts × Charles M. Schulz Museum and Research Center
events.address: 25 Little West 12th Street, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A 16,000-square-foot Peanuts cultural exhibition with ten immersive zones exploring Snoopy's influence on fashion, music, sports and pop culture, including one-of-a-kind Snoopy and Woodstock designer looks, archival material, Joe Cool's Listening Lounge and a curated gift shop.
events.what_is_free: General admission to the exhibition is complimentary. Merchandise in the curated gift shop is for purchase.
events.caveats: Peanuts' official release says the exhibition is open to the public September 2–26 from 10 AM–6 PM. Secondary current listings explicitly confirm complimentary/free admission. Hours may vary for special events. No advance RSVP requirement is published in the verified sources.
events.practical_notes: Open daily through Saturday Sept. 26, generally 10 AM–6 PM, at 25 Little West 12th Street. Free public walk-in exhibition; gift-shop purchases are optional.
